_help: Your policy knobs. Every threshold needs a one-sentence 'why' (you'll be asked in the demo). evaluate.py warns while any 'why' still says TODO.
on_ezio_failure_why: We must review failed Ezio calls to ensure no bad content gets through.
tier_decisions_why: Yellow indicates some risk requiring human review, while red is definitely unsafe.

tone.why: Tone must be at least 60 to maintain a polite brand voice.

bias.why: Bias score below 60 suggests potential discrimination.

agreement.why: Low agreement suggests the response might contradict the user.

when_accuracy_not_scored_why: If no claims were extracted, accuracy cannot be evaluated, so we ignore it.
when_accuracy_unavailable_why: We hold unverified facts to manually confirm them before sending.
